initial.chief_complaint: Wheezing and chest tightness; I use my blue inhaler a lot.

presenting_complaint: Wheezing and chest tightness; I use my blue inhaler a lot.
history_freetext:
Cough, wheeze and chest tightness for about a year, worse with exercise, cold air and cats. Uses her salbutamol (blue reliever) inhaler about 4 to 5 days a week.
Wakes at night with cough or wheeze about twice a week. Has had no emergency visits, no oral steroids and no hospital stays in the last year.
Childhood eczema and hay fever. No other illness. Does not smoke; no one smokes at home. Has a cat.
Takes only salbutamol as needed; does not take any daily controller medicine. No allergies to drugs.
